about: HAX icon name -> the closest icon by meaning in each design system's icon set (a column per set). Bridges pick a column with icons.map in bridge.json; build-bridge.js copies those icons into the theme and writes lib/<Prefix>Icons.js. Names not listed keep HAX's own icon. HAX's own sets (hax, lrn, mdi-social brands, stopnoteicons, ...) are never mapped. Material Symbols are mapped by name (HAX's Material icons share their lineage); the other columns map by meaning. Review a new column by eye before shipping it.
